contextNotes.GoodGriefShirt_Name: Good grief is an exclamation, rendered Забога rather than literal good sadness; retain the source quotation marks.
contextNotes.PlainShirt_Name_Female: The source explicitly labels garment variants (F)/(M). These are display suffixes, not commands: use Cyrillic (Ж)/(М) consistently for all gendered garment variants.
contextNotes.TankTop_Description: The garment is specifically sleeveless; use мајица без рукава for Tank Top while the generic Shirt category remains canonical Кошуља.
contextNotes.CropTankTop_Description: Crop here is a shortened garment cut, not a farming crop.
